elements.name: siwa.is_supported
elements.description: Check if Sign in with Apple is available (iOS 13+).

elements.name: siwa.get_credential_state
elements.description: Get the credential state of a user.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.doc: User id to get credential state for.

elements.examples:
siwa.get_credential_state(id, function(self, data)
	if data.credential_state == siwa.STATE_AUTHORIZED then
		print("User has still authorized the application", data.user_id)
	elseif data.credential_state == siwa.STATE_REVOKED then
		print("User has revoked authorization for the application", data.user_id)
	end
end)

elements.name: siwa.authenticate
elements.description: Show the Sign in with Apple UI

fields.name: state
fields.doc: The authentication result data (user_id, identity_token, email, first_name, family_name, status, result)

elements.examples:
siwa.authenticate(function(self, data)
	print(data.identity_token)
	print(data.user_id)
	print(data.first_name, data.family_name)
	print(data.email)
	if data.user_status == siwa.STATUS_LIKELY_REAL then
		print("Likely a real person")
	end
end)

elements.name: siwa.STATE_REVOKED
elements.brief: Authorization for the given user has been revoked.
elements.description: Authorization for the given user has been revoked.

elements.name: siwa.STATUS_UNKNOWN
elements.brief: The system hasn’t determined whether the user might be a real person.
elements.description: The system hasn’t determined whether the user might be a real person.

elements.name: siwa.STATUS_UNSUPPORTED
elements.brief: The system can’t determine this user’s status as a real person.
elements.description: The system can’t determine this user’s status as a real person.

elements.name: siwa.STATUS_LIKELY_REAL
elements.brief: The user appears to be a real person.
elements.description: The user appears to be a real person.
